text:
Elaine: Heads-up — Silverpine on‑prem deployment window is tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC. This thread for runbook handoff + quick checks. Please confirm your ownership.
Jun: I can own platform changes + kube apply. I'll be oncall during the window. ETA: available 01:30 UTC to help.
Rohan: I'll handle the network cutover (NAT rules, IP allowlist) and VPN handoff with the customer's infra contact.
Marta: I'll run smoke tests and service health checks post-cutover. What endpoints do you want on the smoke list?
Cal: App team here — will validate auth + inference path. Can we get a short preflight checklist? :+1:
Elaine: Preflight checklist (quick):
- confirm package build ID: silverpine@v2.3.1
- customer certs loaded to /etc/redwood/certs/
- kube manifests reviewed and imagePullSecrets set
- DB migration NOOP scheduled (if required)
- monitoring dashboards ready + Grafana links
- rollback plan reviewed

Jun: adding a small command snippet to apply manifests (we'll run in staging first then prod):
```
kubectl --context=silverpine-prod apply -f /deploy/silverpine/v2.3.1/manifests/
```

Elaine: Smoke endpoints for Marta:
- GET https://silverpine.internal/api/health
- POST https://silverpine.internal/api/predict (simple payload)
- GET https://silverpine.internal/metrics

Marta: Got it. I'll also run a light load test (50 rps) against /predict for ~60s.
Sara: I'll coordinate with customer PM (Amit) and confirm their maintenance window still holds. I'll also request VPN access for Cal if needed.
Rohan: Network notes — we need to add 3 customer IPs to the ACL and update the edge LB config. I'll post the exact IPs in #vendors once confirmed.
Cal: For rollback, prefer image rollback + config revert. Minimal steps:
1) kubectl rollout undo deployment/silverpine-api --to-revision=REV
2) revert LB change (restore previous config version)

Elaine: ops-bot scheduled maintenance reminder:
ops-bot: "Maintenance window: silverpine onprem — 3512346789 — Reminder set for 30m before start."

Jun: I'll take screenshots of pod restarts / events during deploy for postmortem if anything odd.
Marta: Expected smoke checks timeline: within first 6 minutes after pods ready. If anything fails, mark P0 and follow rollback plan.
Elaine: Can everyone confirm primary contact during the window? Assigning roles:
- Platform deploy: Jun
- Networking: Rohan
- Smoke/QA: Marta
- App validation: Cal
- Customer comms: Sara

Jun: confirmed
Rohan: confirmed
Marta: confirmed
Cal: confirmed
Sara: confirmed

Elaine: One more — please ensure logs are being shipped to the ephemeral S3 bucket (silverpine-smoke-logs) and retention set to 7d.
Jun: I'll enable additional debug log level for 15m after deploy to capture anything strange.
Rohan: I'll be on standby in case we need to revert NAT rules. Keep me pinged.
Cal: After smoke, I'll run a quick sanity inference with full prompt to validate KV cache behavior.
Marta: If smoke passes, I'll post a short verdict message with timestamps and sample response IDs.
Elaine: Thanks all. If nothing else, meet here for a quick post-deploy debrief at 04:10 UTC. :rocket:
deploy-bot: "Deployment job queued: silverpine-prod-v2.3.1 — approver required: Jun — ETA 02:00 UTC"
